title: k[[ℝa]] is supported in ℝa and has density k at every point of ℝa (parent step 6)
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, C ∈ 𝒟_1(ℝ^P), F a finite set of unit vectors and m : ℝ^P → ℤ with C(ω) = Σ_{e∈F} m(e)·∫_{(0,∞)} ω(te)(e) dt for every ω ∈ 𝒟¹(ℝ^P). Let a ∈ F with −a ∈ F such that every e ∈ F with m(e) ≠ 0 equals a or −a, and let k ∈ ℕ with m(a) = k and m(−a) = −k (so that C = k[[ℝa]]). Then spt C ⊆ span{a} = ℝa, and Θ¹(μ_C, y) = k, i.e. HasMassDensity C y k, for every y ∈ ℝa.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) 1) (F : Finset (Euclid P)), (∀ e ∈ F, ‖e‖ = 1) → ∀ m : Euclid P → ℤ, (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) 1, C ω = ∑ e ∈ F, (m e : ℝ) * ∫ t in Ioi (0 : ℝ), (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) 1) (t • e) (fun _ => e)) → ∀ a ∈ F, -a ∈ F → (∀ e ∈ F, m e ≠ 0 → e = a ∨ e = -a) → ∀ k : ℕ, m a = k → m (-a) = -k → C.support ⊆ (Submodule.span ℝ {a} : Set (Euclid P)) ∧ ∀ y ∈ Submodule.span ℝ {a}, HasMassDensity C y k
